```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE, error = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(ggplot2)
})
```

# load demultiplexing assignment

the per-cell sampletag assignment is computed once by demux_sampletags.R (the
same table the per-sampletag count splitting consumes) so the figures here and the
split count matrices cannot diverge. each row is one cell barcode.

```{r load}
demux <- as.data.frame(fread(
    cmd = paste("zcat", shQuote(params$demux_path)),
    sep = "\t", header = TRUE
))

cat(sprintf("cells with sampletag reads: %d\n", nrow(demux)))
cat(sprintf("sampletags called: %s\n",
            paste(sort(unique(na.omit(demux$called_tag))), collapse = ", ")))
print(table(demux$status))
print(table(demux$called_tag, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# distributions

```{r plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(demux, aes(x = total_reads, fill = status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "white") +
    labs(title = "total sampletag reads per cell", x = "reads", y = "cells") +
    theme_bw()

ggplot(demux[demux$status %in% c("highqual", "called"), ],
       aes(x = called_tag, fill = called_tag)) +
    geom_bar() +
    labs(title = "called cell counts per sampletag", x = "sampletag", y = "cells") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(demux, aes(x = dominant_frac, fill = status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.75, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
    labs(title = "dominant sampletag fraction per cell",
         x = "fraction of reads from top tag", y = "cells") +
    theme_bw()

# the noise trend is fit on high-quality singlets; recover the displayed slope
# from their noise_reads vs total_reads (no intercept), matching demux_sampletags.R
hq <- demux[demux$status == "highqual" & is.finite(demux$noise_reads), ]
slope <- if (nrow(hq) >= 2 && var(hq$total_reads) > 0) {
    max(sum(hq$total_reads * hq$noise_reads) / sum(hq$total_reads^2), 0)
} else {
    0
}
ggplot(hq, aes(x = total_reads, y = noise_reads)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = slope, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "noise trend (high-quality singlets)",
         subtitle = sprintf("slope = %.4f", slope),
         x = "total sampletag reads", y = "noise reads") +
    theme_bw()
```

# concordance with ground truth (simulated data only)

```{r concordance}
if (!is.null(params$assignments_path) && nzchar(params$assignments_path) &&
        file.exists(params$assignments_path)) {
    truth = read.table(params$assignments_path, header = TRUE,
                       sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(truth) = c("cb", "true_tag")
    merged = merge(demux, truth, by = "cb", all.x = TRUE)
    n_concordant = sum(merged$called_tag == merged$true_tag, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_called_any = sum(merged$status %in% c("highqual", "called"))
    cat(sprintf("concordance: %d / %d called cells match ground truth (%.1f%%)\n",
                n_concordant, n_called_any,
                100 * n_concordant / max(n_called_any, 1)))
    print(table(called = merged$called_tag, truth = merged$true_tag, useNA = "ifany"))
} else {
    cat("no ground-truth assignments file provided - skipping concordance check.\n")
}
```
